body.chapter_job: Establish Marcus’s distrust of systems, leave the Astria anomaly unresolved, and stage the anonymous Marcus–Dead Hand star rogue duel so it earns mutual recognition before Astria hijacks the scrim into coerced participation.
body.chapter_spine: Marcus spots a control-cohort drift that should be impossible, enters a Dead Hand scrim where he and Dead Hand star rogue recognize each other mid-duel, and then watches Astria convert the match into a consent trap.
body.global_exit_state: The scrim has been hijacked by Astria; logout and normal match authority are compromised; Marcus, Seb, Brent, and Mathias have verbally consented under duress; Marcus and Dead Hand star rogue have recognized each other during the duel but have not resolved their personal history.
